name: Bantr
notes: Text-message assistant for couples and families by The Social Company of the United States: reminders, daily briefs, shared schedules and budgets, calendar events, read-only Gmail triage, a shared memory. No app; iMessage, SMS or WhatsApp. Waitlist at submission time; USD subscription, amount not stated. Requested via the form (issue #308).
tagline: A text-message assistant for couples and families
